name: Palevow
blurb: Remake of s2 + s3 (old stages were washed-out gold cathedral scenes that looked alike). LOCAL ONLY. Painterly porcelain style + friendly big-eyed face of the Relic Squire kept; color moved to sky-blue / sapphire so stages read apart. Bot picks: Adolescent A (striding squire with oath-scroll and shield, sunny ivy courtyard), Legend A (oath-knight raising a shining sword under a halo in a sapphire stained-glass cathedral, glowing blank scroll aura). CONFIRM = ship; REMAKE = stays local.

A.title: striding squire, oath-scroll with blue ribbon, shield, ivy courtyard

B.title: kneeling vow in a flower meadow, blank scroll, practice sword
B.note: calmer pose, less 'more active' than A/C

C.title: leaping training swing, teal cape, scroll in belt pouch, training yard

D.title: lantern-bearer on a stone bridge at dusk, rose cape, fireflies
D.note: proportions read younger/chibi - weaker step up from the Hatchling

A.title: sword raised under a halo, sapphire stained-glass cathedral, glowing scroll aura

B.title: sword planted on a peak at sunrise, light-ribbon aura, cathedral spires

C.title: glowing shield + scroll under a starry aurora, floating scrolls
C.fail: floating scrolls carry scribble lines that read as writing (letter-like text)

D.title: winged knight with halo striding down a red-carpet nave
D.note: backdrop pale cream/gold - closest to the old washed-out look; weakest at thumbnail

E.title: leaping with a blazing sword, giant blank scroll trail, sea cathedral
E.note: pose echoes Adolescent C's leap - if Ash picks Adol C, prefer Legend A or B
